text: Aventro Bolt Sedan is a premium mid-size sedan from Aventro Motors, designed for comfort, performance, and innovation. It is available in four fuel types—Petrol, Diesel, Electric, and Hybrid—each offered in three trims: Base, X, and ZX.

- Sunroof: Available in ZX trim
